title: Universal GUI release — Windows ARM64, NSIS installers, .deb packages
highlights: GUI now builds for Windows ARM64 alongside x86_64, bringing full desktop coverage to 5 platform targets: Linux x86_64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows x86_64, and Windows ARM64.
NSIS installer enabled on Windows for a lighter, faster install experience alongside the existing MSI.
Debian .deb package now produced for Linux, in addition to AppImage.
TUI binary coverage remains at 7 targets: Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS aarch64/x86_64, Windows x86_64/aarch64, FreeBSD x86_64.
improvements: Cross-compilation support in CI: build-gui auto-detects host vs target architecture and passes --target to tauri build when needed.
MSVC cross-tools step added for Windows ARM64 GUI builds.
Package step handles cross-compiled target directories (target/<triple>/release/).
SHA256SUMS and platform availability updated to cover all new artifact formats.
Bundle config updated: nsis, msi, dmg, appimage, deb all enabled.
fixes: Added NSIS installer output handling in package step.
Added .deb to Linux artifact collection in package step.
Windows ARM64 GUI cross-compilation uses same MSVC setup as TUI build.
Asset attach step updated to include .nsis.exe files.
